Subject: Stakeholder map & mutual action plan — next steps

Hi Ana / Liam —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we agreed:
- Primary use case: customer-facing chat + order reconciliation for US accounts.
- Success metric: reduce support handle time by 30% for billing-related inquiries; target latency <300ms for token path.
- Decision criteria: security review (SOC2 + data residency), total cost of ownership, integration effort with existing billing systems.
- Timeline: target contract signature by end of Q1 2027 (you mentioned procurement process in Dec/Jan).

As discussed, two immediate asks from your side:
1) Please confirm the stakeholder list (role + name + best email/phone) for security, legal, procurement, and the economic buyer.
2) Share any mandatory procurement checklist or vendor questionnaire we should prepare for (e.g., DSAs, cyber insurance limits, specific compliance artifacts).

I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones we discussed (FinPay-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx). Proposed MAP milestones:
- Week 1: stakeholder list + procurement checklist received
- Week 2-3: security review (SOC2 docs + questionnaire)
- Week 4: pilot plan + technical deep-dive/demo prep
- Week 6: procurement & legal review (contract redlines)
- Week 8: final decision / contract sign

Would you be able to confirm stakeholders and procurement contact by EOD Monday? If so, I'll update the MAP and schedule a 60-minute technical walkthrough for the relevant security/infra folks.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
